Mehendi ceremonies are such a beautiful and meaningful part of many South Asian wedding traditions. The intricate henna designs are not only a symbol of good luck and prosperity but also a way to bring the family and friends together in celebration. I'm sure it was a wonderful experience for you and your family to share this special moment together. What was your favorite part of the mehendi ceremony?
